courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 側槽式溢洪道
related.transfer: 可遷移「臨界水深與單寬流量」與「近壁低壓與氣蝕」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；側槽式溢洪道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Critical depth and unit discharge" and "Near-wall pressure and cavitation" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Side-channel spillways must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能；側槽式溢洪道則以以側向入流動量及沿程水面控制側槽為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy; Side-channel spillways centres on controlling side channels through lateral inflow momentum and profiles, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「臨界水深與單寬流量」與「沿程入流與累積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到側槽式溢洪道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「波峰餘高與牆頂」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Critical depth and unit discharge” and “Lateral inflow accumulation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Side-channel spillways, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wave allowance and wall crest", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 豎井式溢洪道

以「下游管流摩阻」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Critical depth and unit discharge” and “Circular crest free flow”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shaft spillways, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 階梯式溢洪道
history.text: 本課所研究的以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「臨界水深與單寬流量」到「縮尺黏性與可比性」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Critical depth and unit discharge" through "Scale viscosity and comparability" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
